correctness.rationale: The entire lift spectrum follows from orthogonality of Weyl-operator conjugation characters; the finite geometric-series identity is derived explicitly with cyclic wrap-around. The two terms in its numerator can cancel only at the half shift for nonunit radius, and exact phase tests identify precisely \(N/2\) zeros. Unit-radius zeros are counted by \(\gcd(a,N)\). All resonant singular-value slopes and the sharp minimum are proved from the exact numerator and root-of-unity geometry. A separately constructed direct projector-matrix checker passed 305 finite numerical assertions. The universal claim is analytic, not an extrapolation from the checks.

value.rationale: This is a complete, naturally defined two-real-parameter classification of cyclic exponential-window measurement invertibility, including a nontrivial arithmetic rank jump on the unit circle and an exactly \(N/2\)-dimensional resonance defect. The sharp individual singular slopes quantify the precise instability of phase tuning, addressing robust selection of complex geometric windows rather than arbitrary numerical slices. It does not merely reprove the known nonzero-ambiguity criterion or the fixed 2026 construction.
